title: Rohit Sharma 264 Against Sri Lanka 2014 Full Highlights
quote_text:
Rohit Sharma 264 Against Sri Lanka 2014 Full Highlights #cricket #crickethighlights #cricket 

Rohit Sharma's historic innings of 264 runs against Sri Lanka on November 13, 2014, at Eden Gardens, Kolkata, is one of the most remarkable feats in ODI cricket history. This knock not only broke records but also set new benchmarks for batting in One Day Internationals.

Key Highlights of the Innings:

Record-Breaking Score: Rohit Sharma scored 264 off 173 balls, setting the record for the highest individual score in an ODI, which still stands.

Explosive Boundaries: He struck 33 fours and 9 sixes, displaying a mix of powerful hitting and precise placement.

Reaching Milestones: He reached his double century in 151 balls and continued to accelerate, scoring the last 64 runs off just 28 balls.

Setting Up a Big Total: India posted a massive total of 404/5, largely thanks to Rohit’s incredible innings.

Impact on the Match: Sri Lanka, in response, was bowled out for 251, giving India a comprehensive 153-run victory.


Rohit's 264 is remembered for its incredible power, timing, and endurance, showcasing why he's known as one of the greatest ODI openers. This performance solidified his reputation and remains an unforgettable moment in cricketing history.
